📸 Mañanera del Pueblo — Villahermosa, Tabasco, 25 de septiembre de 2026

🇲🇽✊ "Thanks to the work we did in Mexico, which is at the vanguard in the world for platform workers, today the ILO has a guideline for all the countries of the world." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, on social security for app workers About one million app workers were enrolled in IMSS, Mexico's social security institute, during the World Cup. Everyone working through the platforms is enrolled. Those earning less than the minimum wage are covered for health care and accidents. Those earning at least the minimum wage get full labor rights and IMSS benefits, including a pension.

🇲🇽🏭 "The Mexican economy is doing well, even with the United States' tariffs." "Jobs are being created, there is investment, and we are moving forward. And public investment is going to be even greater in 2027." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum According to INEGI's national employment survey, more than one million jobs were created in a year. The economically active population reached 62.6 million people in August 2026, 1.3 million more than in August 2025.
banner: OVER 1 MILLION JOBS IN A YEAR

text: 🇲🇽🌎 Mexico broke five historic tourism records from January to July. "That's why we say tourism generates economic spillover, yes, but above all shared prosperity." — Josefina Rodríguez Zamora, Secretary of Tourism INEGI data: 59.7 million international visitors (+7% year on year) and 28.9 million international tourists (+4.5%, against 3% growth worldwide). Cruise passengers reached 7.4 million (+13.6%). Tourism employment hit its highest level on record, 9.3% of national employment, and 54% of those jobs are held by women. Despite the global air travel slump, Mexico gained 140 new air routes.

🇲🇽✊ Tabasco's small cacao growers will get 100 fermenting and drying modules, so they stop selling their beans raw. "It is not the same in terms of price. Even if it's four or five more days of work, the price rises a lot when you sell cacao fermented and dried instead of 'en baba.'" — María Luisa Albores, director of Alimentación para el Bienestar The first cacao census in 15 years counted 16,771 growers on 23,949 hectares, averaging 1.33 hectares each. 61% sell their cacao raw. The federal government is putting 32 million pesos into the modules (6,000-ton capacity). A 126-million-peso Bienestar chocolate plant will be built at Finca El Morralero in Comalcalco, and the state will buy 1,000 tons next cycle at a fair price.
📸 Honestidad y resultados — Puebla, 24 de septiembre de 2026

🇲🇽🌎 "Mexico is a free, independent and sovereign country." "That is why the people of Mexico, to this day, have a mark, a seal — they carry it in their hearts: we decide in our country." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Honesty and Results, Puebla In the city of the May 5, 1862 victory over the French, Sheinbaum traced the invasions Mexico has resisted: the US war that took more than half its territory — which Ulysses S. Grant later called "very unjust" — the French intervention and Maximilian, and the 1914 US attempt opposed by every revolutionary faction.
📸 Visita de Estado del presidente de Corea, Lee Jae-myung — Palacio Nacional, 24 de septiembre de 2026

🇲🇽🌎 Mexico and Korea: "the defense of multilateralism, international law, the peaceful settlement of disputes, and the sovereignty of States." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, with President Lee Jae-myung at the National Palace Bilateral trade reached $27 billion in 2025; Korean investment since 2006 tops $11.5 billion across more than 2,000 companies. The two governments signed 17 memoranda of understanding and a 2026–2030 Action Plan, with Korean suppliers to open their chains to Mexican SMEs under Plan México. Korea chairs the G20 in 2028, the year Mexico hosts APEC.
